surface_mechanism_description: The PMAM layer effectively blocks Pt deposition by preventing the diffusion of the Pt precursor into the polymer, likely due to its low diffusivity in PMAM or the absence of water as a reactant in this ALD process, which contrasts with other systems where water uptake in the polymer could contribute to growth.
